node.title: Deficiency-aware bivariate kernel reduction
node.closure: exact polynomial factorization and coefficient extraction
node.statement: At the putative strict rate-half endpoint T=4m+1, write Delta_x=m-d_x and factor the nonzero parameter polynomial Q_Y(x)=A_x(Y)R_x(Y), where A_x is the product over its supported slope roots and deg R_x<=Delta_x. For a joint support W, coefficient extraction from the apolar word gives an explicit (m+2)(4m+1)-by-U_W matrix M_W with a blockwise-nonzero kernel vector, where U_W=|W|+sum_(x in W)Delta_x<=|W|+1+O<=|W|+m. When O=0, U_W is exactly |W| or |W|+1 according as the unique deficient point lies outside or inside W. The earlier one-scalar product formula is therefore exact only at saturated coordinates. Full column rank would exclude a counterexample, but row count alone is not a rank proof.
